Lead decisions applied: amesweb (calculator) not a source; a rival value printed by 2+ independent lineages removes the row; cells of another standard printed under the target title (verified equal to that standard's table) are neither support nor rival; pages reproducing the standard's text (boltport ISO 4035) excluded. A cluster whose own pages give two different values for a cell is not counted for it. Largest rectangle (cells, then rows) chosen among column subsets that contain the drawing keys.
